inputs.name: AuthRecordValidator.challenge.value
inputs.description: A stored challenge row consumed when validating a persisted challenge. It must be a non-null object with non-empty string id_hash, nonce, and csrf_hash fields and a safe-integer expires_at; invalid rows throw the corruption Error.
inputs.unknownReason: The challenge row is raw database data until the expected columns have been checked.

inputs.name: AuthRecordValidator.session.value
inputs.description: A stored session row consumed when validating a persisted session. kind must be browser or native, required text fields must be non-empty strings, numeric fields must be safe integers, and null or missing parent_hash and revoked_at become null.
inputs.unknownReason: The session row must be checked for known kinds and session columns after reading it from storage.

inputs.name: AuthRecordValidator.githubState.value
inputs.description: A stored GitHub state row consumed when validating a persisted OAuth state. Its required text columns must be non-empty strings and grant_generation and expires_at must be safe integers.
inputs.unknownReason: The saved OAuth state is raw database data until its required columns are verified.

inputs.name: AuthRecordValidator.grant.value
inputs.description: A stored GitHub grant row consumed when validating a persisted grant. actor_id, login, and cipher text fields must be non-empty strings, github_user_id and created_at and expires_at must be safe integers, and null or missing token and refresh metadata becomes null.
inputs.unknownReason: The persisted grant row must be checked before its actor and encrypted fields are used.

inputs.name: AuthRecordValidator.emailProof.value
inputs.description: A stored email proof row consumed when validating a persisted proof. Required text fields must be non-empty strings, integer columns must be safe integers, and claimed must be exactly numeric 0 or 1; null or missing code_hash and code_expires_at becomes null.
inputs.unknownReason: The email proof row comes from storage and its required text fields are checked on read.

inputs.name: AuthRecordValidator.verifiedEmail.value
inputs.description: A stored verified-email row consumed when validating a persisted email verification. actor_id and email_hash must be non-empty strings, and verified_at and expires_at must be safe integers.
inputs.unknownReason: The stored email verification row is not typed until the actor and email fields are validated.

inputs.name: AuthRecordValidator.grantState.value
inputs.description: A stored grant-state row consumed when validating the current grant generation. generation must be a safe integer; a non-null revoked_at makes a tombstone and skips the other columns, while an unrevoked row must also contain a valid grant and may have a nullable refreshing_until.
inputs.unknownReason: The raw grant-state row must be checked for a valid generation and required fields.

inputs.name: AuthRecordValidator.exchange.value
inputs.description: A stored native exchange row consumed when validating a persisted native exchange. environment must be local, staging, or production; status must be pending, approved, or consumed; required text fields must be non-empty strings, optional subject and parent_hash become null when null or missing, and expires_at must be a safe integer.
inputs.unknownReason: The stored native exchange row needs validation, including environment and destination checks.

outputs.name: AuthRecordValidator.challenge
outputs.description: The typed challenge record returned from the stored row. Its idHash, nonce, and csrfHash are copied as non-empty strings, and expiresAt is copied from a safe integer.

outputs.name: AuthRecordValidator.session
outputs.description: The typed session record returned from the stored row, including its actor and nullable parentHash and revokedAt. kind is limited to browser or native, and actor.emailVerified is always true.

outputs.name: AuthRecordValidator.githubState
outputs.description: The typed GitHub state record returned from the stored row. idHash, sessionHash, actorId, and verifierCipher are non-empty strings, while grantGeneration and expiresAt are safe integers.

outputs.name: AuthRecordValidator.grant
outputs.description: The typed GitHub grant record returned from the stored row. githubUserId, createdAt, and expiresAt are safe integers; the token and refresh expiry and cipher fields are nullable when their stored columns are null or missing.

outputs.name: AuthRecordValidator.emailProof
outputs.description: The typed email proof record returned from the stored row, with its actor marked emailVerified and claimed converted from numeric 0 or 1 to a boolean. codeHash and codeExpiresAt are null when their stored columns are null or missing.

outputs.name: AuthRecordValidator.verifiedEmail
outputs.description: The typed verified-email record returned from the stored row. actorId and emailHash are non-empty strings, and verifiedAt and expiresAt are safe integers.

outputs.name: AuthRecordValidator.grantState
outputs.description: The typed grant state returns its safe-integer generation, a grant or null, and refreshingUntil or null. A revoked row is a tombstone with grant and refreshingUntil both null, regardless of its other columns.

outputs.name: AuthRecordValidator.exchange
outputs.description: The typed native exchange record returned from the stored row. environment and status use their declared enum values, subject and parentHash are nullable, and expiresAt is a safe integer.

errors.name: AuthRecordCorruptError
errors.description: Throws Error with message 'Hub auth record corrupt' when the value is not a non-null row object or a required field is invalid; malformed present optional fields and values outside the allowed enums also throw.
